quest.3EC8A0B89788D079.title: Flippers
quest.3EC8A0B89788D079.quest_desc: &bFlippers&r — Equip in the feet curio slot to gain a strong swim-speed boost underwater.
&eTip:&r Stack with Depth Strider boots for record-breaking ocean dives.
quest.2215FB0777D7029D.title: Steadfast Spikes
quest.2215FB0777D7029D.quest_desc: &dSteadfast Spikes&r — Curio boots that completely negate incoming knockback.
&7Essential against piglins, blazes, and Create cannons.&r
&eTip:&r Pair with a shield for an unmovable melee build.
quest.4A7AEBEB87CEC274.title: Running Shoes
quest.4A7AEBEB87CEC274.quest_desc: &bRunning Shoes&r — Boots curio that grants a permanent movement-speed bonus.
&7Hidden in dungeon chests across the Overworld.&r
&eTip:&r Combine with Soul Speed enchant for blistering nether travel.
quest.122E6E7CABCB17E7.title: Kitty Slippers
quest.122E6E7CABCB17E7.quest_desc: &bKitty Slippers&r — Boots curio that nullifies fall damage from short drops and silences footsteps.
&eTip:&r Pair with the Scarf of Invisibility for full ninja mode.
quest.5040B3D29F238BC0.title: Bunny Hoppers
quest.5040B3D29F238BC0.quest_desc: &bBunny Hoppers&r — Boots curio that grants a hefty jump-height boost.
&7Crafted by enchanted hares, or so the legend goes.&r
&eTip:&r Stacks well with the Helium Flamingo for vertical exploration.
quest.4D3379D38237F830.title: Aqua Dashers
quest.4D3379D38237F830.quest_desc: &dAqua Dashers&r — Boots curio granting massive underwater swim speed.
&eTip:&r Essential gear for raiding ocean monuments and Aquaculture loot.
quest.7188DC06A28AE30E.title: Golden Hook
quest.7188DC06A28AE30E.quest_desc: &6Golden Hook&r — Belt curio that lassos mobs and pulls them toward you on right-click.
&7Perfect for kidnapping villagers or yanking enemies off cliffs.&r
&eTip:&r Range scales with the entity's size and weight.
quest.73FC51144FC2DA52.title: Vampiric Glove
quest.73FC51144FC2DA52.quest_desc: &dVampiric Glove&r — Hand curio that heals you for a portion of melee damage dealt.
&eTip:&r Combine with high attack damage to maximize the heal per swing.
quest.3B3BD39BA02DCA13.title: Pocket Piston
quest.3B3BD39BA02DCA13.quest_desc: &dPocket Piston&r — Hand curio that boosts the knockback of every attack.
&7Send enemies flying without an enchanted weapon.&r
&eTip:&r Stacks with Knockback enchant for catapult-tier launches.
quest.427014BDE06DE631.title: Fire Gauntlet
quest.427014BDE06DE631.quest_desc: &6Fire Gauntlet&r — Hand curio that ignites enemies on every melee hit.
&7Acts like a permanent Fire Aspect, no enchant needed.&r
&eTip:&r Pair with Flame Pendant so you can dive into your own infernos safely.
quest.3705D303CF423804.title: Power Glove
quest.3705D303CF423804.quest_desc: &dPower Glove&r — Hand curio that adds flat attack damage to your melee strikes.
&7A simple, brutal upgrade for any fighter.&r
&eTip:&r Pairs perfectly with Feral Claws to multiply hits per second.
quest.6A452BFC8A967C39.title: Feral Claws
quest.6A452BFC8A967C39.quest_desc: &dFeral Claws&r — Hand curio that significantly increases attack speed.
&eTip:&r Best paired with Vampiric Glove for relentless lifesteal.
quest.3525D5DCC3A534D9.title: Digging Claws
quest.3525D5DCC3A534D9.quest_desc: &bDigging Claws&r — Hand curio that boosts tool mining speed against stone and earth.
&eTip:&r Stack with Efficiency V and Haste II for near-instant mining.
quest.589F1D502F680075.title: Helium Flamingo
quest.589F1D502F680075.quest_desc: &dHelium Flamingo&r — Necklace curio granting +30% jump height and 50% fall-damage reduction.
&7Hidden in dungeon loot — a true gem for explorers.&r
&eTip:&r Stacks with Feather Falling enchant for total air control.
quest.623796B1D7981E59.title: Crystal Heart
quest.623796B1D7981E59.quest_desc: &dCrystal Heart&r — Necklace curio granting bonus maximum health.
&7A heart of solid amethyst that pulses with vitality.&r
&eTip:&r Combine with Iron Heart and Resistance potions for true tank builds.
quest.1E40ACF3E69A4100.title: Antidote Vessel
quest.1E40ACF3E69A4100.quest_desc: &dAntidote Vessel&r — Belt curio that fully negates poison and wither effects.
&7Cave spiders, witches, and wither skeletons fear you.&r
&eTip:&r Mandatory equipment when raiding swamp huts and ancient cities.
quest.5EB7CE3A1DCD3E9B.title: Universal Attractor
quest.5EB7CE3A1DCD3E9B.quest_desc: &6Universal Attractor&r — Belt curio that pulls all dropped items within a wide radius toward you.
&7Never miss a drop again — ideal for mob farms and mining.&r
&eTip:&r Pair with the Pickaxe Heater for fully automated ore harvesting.
quest.4933CF4675E77D50.title: Obsidian Skull
quest.4933CF4675E77D50.quest_desc: &dObsidian Skull&r — Belt curio that prevents damage from magma blocks and hot terrain.
&eTip:&r Combine with Flame Pendant for total heat immunity.
quest.436E4E3515BCCDE9.title: Cloud in a Bottle
quest.436E4E3515BCCDE9.quest_desc: &6Cloud in a Bottle&r — Belt curio that grants an additional mid-air jump.
&eTip:&r Combine with Bunny Hoppers and Helium Flamingo for triple-vertical traversal.
quest.221C9EDA651144BA.title: Charm of Sinking
quest.221C9EDA651144BA.quest_desc: &bCharm of Sinking&r — Belt curio that lets you sink and walk normally underwater instead of floating up.
&eTip:&r Combine with the Snorkel for hands-free underwater breathing.
quest.3446803FB59D8875.title: Thorn Pendant
quest.3446803FB59D8875.quest_desc: &dThorn Pendant&r — Necklace curio that reflects a portion of melee damage back to attackers.
&7Passive defense — lets cooked mobs fight themselves.&r
&eTip:&r Stacks with the Thorns armor enchantment.
quest.27E951F4F4F6F847.title: Flame Pendant
quest.27E951F4F4F6F847.quest_desc: &6Flame Pendant&r — Necklace curio granting full immunity to fire and lava damage.
&7Better than any Fire Resistance potion — it never wears off.&r
&eTip:&r Essential before exploring the Nether or fighting Blazes.
quest.70C7D92844089DEB.title: Shock Pendant
quest.70C7D92844089DEB.quest_desc: &dShock Pendant&r — Necklace curio granting full immunity to lightning strikes.
&eTip:&r Lets you safely create Charged Creepers for mob-head farming.
quest.0E716B90E60C486B.title: Panic Necklace
quest.0E716B90E60C486B.quest_desc: &dPanic Necklace&r — Necklace curio that grants Speed when your health drops critically low.
&eTip:&r Combine with Cross Necklace for both regen and a getaway burst.
quest.72D6265E35814927.title: Cross Necklace
quest.72D6265E35814927.quest_desc: &dCross Necklace&r — Necklace curio that grants temporary invulnerability after taking heavy damage.
&7Buys you precious seconds to retreat or heal.&r
&eTip:&r Has an internal cooldown — don't rely on it back-to-back.
quest.7503823ACDDB0491.title: Lucky Scarf
quest.7503823ACDDB0491.quest_desc: &6Lucky Scarf&r — Necklace curio that grants a permanent Luck attribute bonus.
&7Better fishing, loot tables, and bounty rolls.&r
&eTip:&r Equip before opening dungeon chests for better drop chances.
quest.145E7D1A88B83DDD.title: Scarf of Invisibility
quest.145E7D1A88B83DDD.quest_desc: &6Scarf of Invisibility&r — Necklace curio that grants Invisibility when sneaking.
&7The ultimate stealth tool — no potion required.&r
&eTip:&r Equip leather armor or none at all to remain fully unseen.
quest.5F5E43B3F51CAE9E.title: Superstitious Hat
quest.5F5E43B3F51CAE9E.quest_desc: &dSuperstitious Hat&r — Head curio granting bonus Luck and improved drop chances.
&eTip:&r Stack with Lucky Scarf for absurdly favorable loot rolls.
quest.73B73870B29DFAD9.title: Villager Hat
quest.73B73870B29DFAD9.quest_desc: &bVillager Hat&r — Head curio that grants a discount on villager trades.
&7Cheaper emerald purchases and better deals overall.&r
&eTip:&r Combine with the Hero of the Village effect for record-low trade prices.
quest.2AD78E22988A92D3.title: Night Vision Goggles
quest.2AD78E22988A92D3.quest_desc: &dNight Vision Goggles&r — Head curio granting permanent Night Vision while worn.
&eTip:&r Especially useful in Deep Dark and modded dimensions where light is scarce.
quest.16255FB20F35A9D9.title: Snorkel
quest.16255FB20F35A9D9.quest_desc: &bSnorkel&r — Head curio that significantly extends underwater breathing time.
&eTip:&r Combine with Charm of Sinking and Aqua Dashers for the full diver kit.
quest.3E0643EA9183CDAE.title: Novelty Drinking Hat
quest.3E0643EA9183CDAE.quest_desc: &bNovelty Drinking Hat&r — Head curio that speeds up potion drinking and food consumption.
&7Chug potions in a heartbeat during combat.&r
&eTip:&r A lifesaver for emergency healing pots in PvP.
quest.2607F3DC07049785.title: Plastic Drinking Hat
quest.2607F3DC07049785.quest_desc: &dPlastic Drinking Hat&r — Head curio that restores hunger whenever you drink a potion.
&7Turn every potion into a snack break.&r
&eTip:&r Combine with brewing-heavy builds for endless food sustain.
quest.789AF6D0A6321945.title: Whoopee Cushion
quest.789AF6D0A6321945.quest_desc: &7Whoopee Cushion&r — A joke item with no real combat use, but unmatched comedic potential.
&7Place it down, wait for someone to step on it... pfffrt.&r
&eTip:&r Excellent for pranking unsuspecting teammates at base.
quest.161A90E134592D0E.title: Eternal Steak
quest.161A90E134592D0E.quest_desc: &6Eternal Steak&r — An infinite food item that never depletes after eating.
&7Solves hunger forever — one bite is all you need to own.&r
&eTip:&r Drop one in every shulker box, you'll never starve again.
quest.4564B577CB4EC046.title: Everlasting Beef
quest.4564B577CB4EC046.quest_desc: &6Everlasting Beef&r — A second infinite food item that never depletes.
&eTip:&r Functionally identical to Eternal Steak — collect both for the trophy.
quest.3E1A3BC8642390B3.title: Umbrella
quest.3E1A3BC8642390B3.quest_desc: &dUmbrella&r — Off-hand item that slows your fall when held and opened mid-air.
&7Mary Poppins style descent — no fall damage.&r
&eTip:&r Combine with Helium Flamingo for an ultra-safe parachute build.
quest.5CE44C58A470E48E.title: Slay the Mimic
quest.5CE44C58A470E48E.quest_desc: &6Mimic Hunter&r — Find and defeat an Artifacts &cMimic&r to complete this quest.
&7Mimics disguise themselves as ordinary chests in dungeons. Approach carefully — they bite hard.&r
&eTip:&r Kill them with melee to maximize artifact drop chance.
